DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 御朱印についてのお尋ねですか。お参りはお済みでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about shrine calligraphy stamps? Have you finished paying your respects?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。先に参拝してから戻りたいのですが、御朱印帳を今預けてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 参拝前に御朱印帳を預けて後で戻れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. I'd like to pay my respects first and come back. May I leave my stamp book now?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can leave your shrine stamp book before worship and return later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用授与所では、お参りの後にお預かりしています。先に帳面をおしまいください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this offering office used for learning, we accept books after worship. Please put your book away for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 承知しました。参拝の作法に自信がないので、簡単に教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 作法に自信がないので簡単な案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'm unsure of the proper way to worship. Could you explain it briefly?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for brief guidance because you're unsure of worship etiquette. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この神社の案内では、二回お辞儀をし、二回手をたたいてお参りし、最後にもう一回お辞儀をします。掲示でも確認できますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: This shrine's guidance says to bow twice, clap twice and pray, then bow once more at the end. You can check the posted instructions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。参拝している家族を撮るときは、どこでも撮影できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 参拝中の家族を撮影できる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. When photographing my family while they worship, can I take photos anywhere?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where you can photograph your family while they worship. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影禁止の表示がある所では控えてください。人の参拝を妨げないことと、他の方が写らない配慮もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please refrain where photography prohibition signs are displayed. Also avoid disturbing others' worship or including other people in your photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では拝殿の前では撮らず、許可された場所で撮ります。御朱印の受付は今日はもう終わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拝殿前の撮影を控え御朱印受付の終了を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't photograph in front of the worship hall; I'll use an allowed location. Is today's stamp reception about to close?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Refrain from photos in front of the worship hall and ask when stamp reception ends. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この場面の受付はあと二十分です。急いで参拝する必要はありません。間に合わなければ次の機会にお受けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: In this scenario, reception closes in twenty minutes. There's no need to rush your worship. If you don't make it, please receive the stamp on another occasion.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 焦らず参拝します。戻って受付中なら帳面を出し、閉まっていたら別の日にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ゆっくり参拝し受付終了なら別の日にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pay my respects without rushing. If reception is still open when I return, I'll present the book. If it's closed, I'll come another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll worship unhurriedly and come another day if reception has closed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞゆっくりお参りください。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけて、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time paying your respects. Thank you for asking. Take care; I'll leave you to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示案内所へようこそ。今日は工房の実演も見ていかれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome to the exhibition information center. Will you watch the workshop demonstration today too?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 興味はありますが、四十分後に迎えの車が来ます。実演を見て入口まで戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四十分後の迎えまでに工房の実演と入口への帰着が可能か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm interested, but my pickup car arrives in forty minutes. Can I watch the demonstration and get back to the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can see the workshop demonstration and return to the entrance before your pickup in forty minutes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面の実演は十五分ですが、工房まで片道十分ほどです。歩く時間を含めると余裕が少ないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this scenario the demonstration is fifteen minutes, and the workshop is about ten minutes away each way. Including walking time leaves little spare time.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 実演の途中で出ると迷惑になりますか。最後まで見ないといけないでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実演を最後まで見ず退出してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Would leaving partway through disturb anyone? Do I have to watch until the end?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may leave the demonstration without watching to the end. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出入りはできますが、作業区域へ入らず見学通路を通ってください。出口は入口と反対側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can come and go, but stay out of the work area and use the visitor passage. The exit is opposite the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出口が反対側なら戻り道を確認したいです。案内所へ続く道は地図のどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 反対側の出口から案内所へ戻る道を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: If the exit is on the opposite side, I'd like to check the way back. Where on the map is the path to the information center?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the route from the opposite-side exit back to the information center. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この点線が戻る通路です。段差がある近道より、実線の外周路のほうが歩きやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: This dotted line is the return passage. The solid-line route around the outside is easier to walk than the shortcut with changes in level.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 迎えを待たせたくないので、今日は案内所の展示だけにします。工房の内容も見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 迎えを優先し案内所の展示で工房の内容を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't want to keep my pickup waiting, so I'll just see the information center exhibits today. Can I see what the workshop does too?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize your pickup and ask to see the workshop content through the information center exhibits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ここに実演の紹介映像があります。五分程度なので、映像を見てから展示を回れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: There's an introductory video of the demonstration here. It's about five minutes, so you can watch it and then see the exhibits.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紹介映像を先に見ます。残り十分になったら入口へ戻るようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紹介映像を見て残り十分で入口へ戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll watch the introductory video first. I'll head back to the entrance when there are ten minutes left.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to watch the introduction video and return to the entrance with ten minutes remaining. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 入口の待合場所も地図に印を付けました。どうぞお楽しみください。それでは失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've also marked the entrance waiting area on the map. Please enjoy your visit. I'll leave you to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書のお尋ねですね。どちらへ提出するものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a certificate. Where will you submit it?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 保険会社に出します。事故の日付が分かる書類と言われましたが、免許証のコピーでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保険会社が事故日付の分かる書類を求め免許証コピーでよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: To my insurance company. They asked for a document showing the accident date. Will a copy of my driver's license do?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the insurer requires a document showing the accident date and ask whether a license copy will do. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 免許証には事故の日付が載っていませんね。依頼文に証明書の名称は書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your license doesn't show the accident date. Does their request state the certificate's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 交通事故証明書と書いてありました。こちらで今日受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 交通事故証明書を警察で今日受け取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says traffic accident certificate. Can I receive it here today?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the police can give you the traffic accident certificate today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 警察でその場で発行するものではありません。申請窓口についての案内をお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: It isn't issued on the spot by the police. We can give you information about where to apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先週の接触事故は交番へ届けました。申請には事故を届けた場所も書くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 交番へ届けた先週の接触事故の申請記入について聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: I reported last week's collision to a police box. Do I also write where I reported the accident on the application?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to fill in the application for last week's collision reported to a police box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内の記入欄には、事故の日時や場所を記します。届けた交番名は、照会が必要な場合のために控えておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: The fields in this guide ask for the accident's date, time and location. Note the police box name in case an inquiry is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 届けた交番と日付は分かります。保険会社へ出すまでの期限は、こちらで延ばせますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保険会社への提出期限を警察が延ばせるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: I know the police box and the date I reported it. Can you extend the deadline for submitting it to the insurance company?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the police can extend the insurer's submission deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保険会社の提出期限はこちらでは変更できません。発行にかかる日数も含めて、保険会社へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can't change the insurance company's submission deadline. Please discuss it with them, including the number of days issuance takes.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では申請先の案内を持ち帰り、保険会社に必要部数と提出期限を聞いてから申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を持帰り保険会社に部数と期限を聞いて申請すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll take the application information home, ask the insurance company how many copies and the submission deadline, and then apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll take the guide home, ask the insurer about copies and the deadline, then apply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 交番名を控えた紙も忘れずにお持ちください。ご相談は以上です。お気をつけて、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Don't forget to bring the paper with the police box name noted too. That concludes our discussion. Take care; goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 咳の薬をお探しですね。乾いた咳でしょうか、それとも痰が出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking for cough medicine. Is it a dry cough, or are you bringing up phlegm?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乾いた咳という意味が分かりません。喉はかゆいですが、何か出てくる感じはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乾いた咳の意味が分からず喉のかゆさと排出感がないことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't understand what a dry cough means. My throat is itchy, but I don't feel anything coming up.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you don't understand dry cough, your throat is itchy, and nothing feels as though it's coming up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 咳をしたときに、粘りのあるものが口へ上がってくるか、という質問です。いつから続いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'm asking whether something sticky comes up into your mouth when you cough. How long has it been going on?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そういうものは出ません。昨日の夜からです。持病というのは、昔かかった病気も全部含みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日夜から痰が出ない咳で昔の病気も持病か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nothing like that comes up. It started last night. Does chronic illness also include all illnesses I had in the past?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the cough without phlegm began last night and ask whether past illnesses count as chronic illnesses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここでは、今も治療や管理をしている病気を確認しています。通院中の病気や、毎日飲んでいる薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here we're checking illnesses you're still treating or managing. Are you receiving care for any illness, or taking medicine every day?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 血圧の薬を毎日飲んでいます。名前を覚えていないので、この薬の袋を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 血圧の薬を毎日飲み名前の代わりに薬袋を見てもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: I take blood pressure medicine daily. I don't remember the name. Could you look at this medicine bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you take blood pressure medicine daily and show its bag instead of giving the forgotten name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拝見します。併用を確認する必要があるので、すぐに商品を決めずに成分を調べますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll have a look. We need to check compatibility, so rather than choosing a product immediately, I'll examine the ingredients.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。この咳止めならどれでも同じだと思っていたのですが、先に買わないほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 咳止めは同じだと思っていたが先に買うべきでないか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I thought all these cough medicines were the same. Should I avoid buying one beforehand?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you thought cough medicines were the same and ask whether you shouldn't buy first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、薬によって成分が違います。服用中の薬を確認してから、使えるものがあるか相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, their ingredients differ. After checking your current medicine, let's discuss whether there's something you can use.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、この箱はいったん棚へ戻します。薬の袋をお渡しするので、確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品を戻し薬袋で併用確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll put this box back on the shelf for now. I'll give you the medicine bag, so please check.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the product and ask to check compatibility using the medicine bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認してから改めてお声がけします。ご相談ありがとうございました。ひとまず失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll speak to you again after checking. Thank you for asking. I'll leave you for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 仕事用のズボンをお探しですか。今お持ちのものは細身の形です。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for work trousers? The ones you're holding have a slim cut.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: しゃがむことが多いので、膝が動かしやすいものが欲しいです。少しゆったりした形はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: しゃがむ仕事に合う膝周りがゆったりしたズボンを探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I squat often, so I'd like trousers that let my knees move easily. Is there a slightly looser cut?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Look for trousers with room around the knees suitable for squatting at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらなら膝周りに余裕があります。同じウエストサイズでも股下が二種類あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: These have more room around the knees. Even with the same waist size, there are two inseam lengths.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 短いほうを試着できますか。靴を履いたときに裾を踏まない長さにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短い股下を試し靴を履いて裾を踏まない長さを確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: May I try the shorter ones? I'd like a length where I won't step on the hems when wearing shoes.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to try the shorter inseam and check a length that won't be stepped on with shoes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 試着室へどうぞ。ご自分の靴と合わせて確認できます。丈が合わなければ補正の相談もできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use the fitting room. You can check with your own shoes. If the length isn't right, you can also ask about alterations.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 短いほうでも少し長いです。裾を直したあとにウエストがきついと気づいたら、交換できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 裾直し後にウエストが合わない場合の交換可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even the shorter ones are a little long. If I realize the waist is tight after having the hems altered, can I exchange them?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can exchange them if the waist doesn't fit after hem alterations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この学習用店舗では、補正後の交換はお受けしていません。先に座ったりしゃがんだりして確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: At this learning store, we don't accept exchanges after alterations. Please sit and squat to check first.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それでは座って試します。ウエストは大丈夫ですが、今日は補正せずに買ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 座ってサイズを確認し補正せず購入できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll try sitting. The waist is fine, but can I buy them without alterations today?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the size while sitting and ask whether you may buy without alterations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。未使用でタグとレシートがある場合の交換期限は、この店舗では七日です。条件を書いた紙をお付けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. In this store, the exchange period is seven days if they're unused and you have the tags and receipt. I'll include a sheet with the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 補正なしでこのサイズにします。家でも丈を確認するので、タグは外さずレシートを保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 補正なしを選びタグとレシートを保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take this size without alterations. I'll check the length at home too, so I'll leave the tags on and keep the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose no alterations and say you'll retain tags and receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 補正のご相談はその後でもできます。お買い上げありがとうございます。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: You can consult us about alterations afterward too. Thank you for your purchase. Please visit again.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお名前をお願いします。お連れ様は後から到着されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please give me your booking name. Will your companion arrive later?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約したグエンです。二人で一泊ですが、友人の電車が遅れて、私だけ先に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: グエン名義の二人一泊予約で友人の電車が遅れ先に来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm Nguyen, the person who booked. It's one night for two, but my friend's train is delayed, so I've come ahead alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the Nguyen booking is one night for two and you arrived first because your friend's train is delayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約画面を確認します。この学習場面ではツインの予約ですね。予約番号を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the booking screen. In this learning scenario, it's a twin booking. Could you show me the booking number?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号です。二つのベッドがある部屋で合っていますか。ダブルを予約した気がして不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約番号を示しツインかダブルか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the number. It's a room with two beds, correct? I'm worried because I feel I booked a double.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the booking number and check twin versus double. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できた予約はツインです。先にご本人の宿泊手続きを進められますが、お連れ様も到着時に受付が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: The confirmed booking is a twin. We can proceed with your own check-in first, but your companion also needs to register on arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人は私の部屋番号を知らないので、フロントに私の名前を言えば案内してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人が名前を伝えれば部屋へ案内できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. My friend doesn't know my room number. If they tell reception my name, can you direct them to the room?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether your friend can be directed to your room by giving your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お名前だけで部屋番号はお伝えしません。到着したら、こちらからお客様へ連絡する形にできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: We don't disclose a room number based only on a name. When they arrive, we can contact you instead.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その方法でお願いします。私は部屋で待ちます。電話に出られなかったら携帯に連絡してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 客室で待ち電話に出られなければ携帯連絡を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do that. I'll wait in my room. If I don't answer the phone, could you contact my mobile?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait in the room and want mobile contact if you don't answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望の連絡先を登録します。まず客室へ、応答がなければ登録した携帯へ連絡する順でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll register your preferred contact number. Is the order first the room, then the registered mobile if there's no answer?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、その順番でお願いします。友人には、到着したら先にフロントへ寄るよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 客室から携帯の連絡順を了承し友人をフロントへ寄らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, in that order, please. I'll tell my friend to stop at reception first on arrival.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept room-then-mobile contact and tell your friend to stop at reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お手続きが済みました。お部屋でゆっくりお待ちください。ご利用ありがとうございます。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your procedure is complete. Please relax while waiting in your room. Thank you for staying with us. I'll leave you to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 歩く距離が分かる案内図はこちらです。全部を回る予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here's a map showing walking distances. Are you planning to see everything?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は足首が少し痛むので、復元建物を一つ見て休めれば十分です。近いものはどれですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 足首に痛みがあり近い復元建物一つと休憩を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: My ankle hurts a little today, so seeing one reconstructed building and resting would be enough. Which one is close?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your ankle hurts and you want one nearby reconstructed building and a rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この仮想の地図では、入口から十分ほどの建物が近いですね。ただ、途中に砂利道があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this imaginary map, a building about ten minutes from the entrance is close. However, there's a gravel path on the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 砂利道で足をひねりそうです。舗装された道だけで行ける展示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 砂利道を避け舗装路だけで行ける展示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I might twist my ankle on gravel. Is there an exhibit I can reach using only paved paths?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for an exhibit reachable only by paved paths, avoiding gravel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら入口近くの展示室が合いそうです。復元建物は映像でも見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then the exhibition room near the entrance may suit you. You can also see the reconstructed buildings on video.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 展示室に変更します。途中で休みたくなったら、入口へ戻る以外に座れる場所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 展示室へ変更し途中で座れる休憩場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll switch to the exhibition room. If I want to rest on the way, is there anywhere to sit other than returning to the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Switch to the exhibition room and ask about a place to sit and rest on the way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示室の手前に休憩所があります。屋内へ入る前でも腰を下ろせますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's a rest area before the exhibition room. You can sit down even before going indoors.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りに別の出口から出ると車のある場所から遠くなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別の出口から駐車場へ戻る距離を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I leave by another exit on the way back, will it be farther from where the car is?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the distance back to the parking lot from another exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 車が入口の駐車場なら、来た舗装路を戻るのが分かりやすいです。別の出口を目指す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your car is in the entrance parking lot, returning by the paved path you came along is easiest to follow. There's no need to head for a different exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休憩所を通って展示室へ行き、足がつらければそこで切り上げて同じ道で車へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩所と展示室を回りつらければ同じ舗装路で車へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go past the rest area to the exhibition room, and if my ankle troubles me, I'll stop there and return to the car the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll visit the rest area and exhibition room and return to the car by the same paved route if it's painful. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 痛みが強ければ無理をなさらないでください。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけて、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: If the pain is strong, don't push yourself. Thank you for asking. Take care; goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: バッグを広げて比べられますよ。何を入れてお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: You can open out the bags to compare them. What will you carry?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車通勤で書類を持ちます。雨の日もあるので、四千円以内で紙が濡れにくいものを探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車通勤の書類を雨から守る四千円以内の鞄を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I commute by bicycle with documents. Some days are rainy, so I'm looking for something costing no more than four thousand yen that keeps paper from getting wet easily.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Look for a bag within four thousand yen to protect documents from rain while cycling to work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 三千六百円のこちらは表面に撥水加工があります。ただ、縫い目や口から水が入ることはあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: This one at three thousand six hundred yen has a water-repellent surface. However, water can enter through seams or the opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 完全に防水ではないのですね。Ａ四のファイルを入れても口は閉まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 完全防水ではないと理解しＡ四ファイルを入れて口が閉まるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it isn't completely waterproof. Will it close with an A4 folder inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge it isn't completely waterproof and ask whether it closes with an A4 folder inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この見本のファイルで試してみましょう。横向きに入れると、ファスナーを閉められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's try with this sample folder. Put in sideways, the zipper will close.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ファイルは入りますね。背負ったときに肩ひもがずれて、運転しにくくなりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 肩ひもがずれて運転しにくくならないか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: The folder fits. Might the shoulder straps slip when worn and make cycling difficult?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether slipping shoulder straps would make cycling difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 胸のベルトで固定できます。試しに背負ってみて、腕を前に伸ばしてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can secure them with the chest strap. Try it on and stretch your arms forward.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これなら動かしやすいです。書類を内側の袋に入れるなら、どんな袋が向いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 試着後に書類を保護する袋の種類を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: This lets me move easily. If I put the documents in a bag inside, what kind would be suitable?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After trying it on, ask what kind of inner bag would protect documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 防水用の書類袋を別に使うと安心です。ここで販売しているものを加えると予算を超えるので、お手持ちの袋も確認してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: A separate waterproof document bag is reassuring. Adding the one sold here would exceed your budget, so check any bags you already have too.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はバッグだけ買います。書類は家の密閉できる袋へ入れ、胸のベルトも使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鞄だけ購入し家の密閉袋と胸ベルトを使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll buy only the bag today. I'll put documents in a sealable bag at home and use the chest strap too.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll buy only the bag and use a sealable bag from home and the chest strap. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 使う前にベルトの長さを調整してください。お買い上げありがとうございました。またお立ち寄りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Adjust the strap length before use. Thank you for your purchase. Please stop by again.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その二つの道具は、形が似ていて迷いますよね。説明いたしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Those two tools look similar, so they're confusing, aren't they? Shall I explain?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。どちらも木でできていますが、同じ作業に使った道具ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た木製道具が同じ作業用か説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please do. Both are wooden. Were they used for the same task?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the similar wooden tools were for the same task and request an explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この展示の説明では、左は材料を押さえる道具、右は表面をならす道具です。横の絵に使い方があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: According to this exhibit's explanation, the left tool holds material in place, and the right one smooths the surface. The picture beside them shows their use.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 絵の中の人が握っているのは、右の道具ですか。実物は手で持ってみてもいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 絵の道具が右の実物か確認し手に持てるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Is the person in the picture holding the tool on the right? May I hold the actual object?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether the pictured tool is the original on the right and ask whether you can hold it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 絵は右の道具を示しています。実物には触れられませんが、体験用の複製は別の台にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: The picture shows the tool on the right. You can't touch the original, but there's a hands-on replica on another stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 複製で試してみたいです。その前に実物と説明文を写真に撮っても構いませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実物と説明文の写真を撮ってから複製を試したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to try the replica. Before that, may I photograph the original and explanatory text?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'd like to photograph the original and text before trying the replica. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この学習用展示では、その二点は撮影できます。フラッシュと三脚は使わず、ほかの来館者への配慮もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this learning exhibit, you may photograph those two items. Please don't use flash or a tripod, and consider other visitors too.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明文の一部が光って読みにくいです。少し横から撮ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明文が光るため横から撮影してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: Part of the text reflects light and is hard to read. May I photograph it slightly from the side?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may photograph from the side because the text reflects light. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路をふさがず、展示ケースに寄りかからなければ大丈夫です。読めない箇所は私がご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's fine if you don't block the passage or lean against the display case. I'll explain the unreadable parts.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 横から一枚撮り、読めない箇所はメモします。その後、複製の台で使い方を試します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 横から撮り読めない箇所をメモして複製体験へ進むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take one photo from the side and note the parts I can't read. Then I'll try using the tool at the replica stand.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll photograph from the side, note unreadable parts, and proceed to the replica activity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 体験用の台は右手です。見学をお楽しみください。ご質問ありがとうございました。それでは失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: The hands-on stand is to your right. Enjoy your visit. Thank you for your questions. I'll leave you to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 行き先表示を見比べていらっしゃいますね。降りたい停留所はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're comparing destination displays. Do you know the stop where you want to get off?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 西口市民センターです。どちらのバスも中央方面と書いてあるので、同じものか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 西口市民センターへ行く二つの中央方面バスを見分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nishiguchi Civic Center. Both buses say toward Central, so I'm unsure whether they're the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to distinguish the two buses toward Central to reach Nishiguchi Civic Center. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用路線表では、二番のりばはセンターへ直行し、三番は途中で乗り換えが必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this learning route chart, platform two goes directly to the center, while platform three requires a transfer on the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 直行のほうがいいです。次の二番のバスには、あとどのくらいで乗れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二番のりばの直行便が何分後か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd prefer the direct one. How long until I can board the next bus at platform two?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how many minutes until the direct service at platform two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この時刻表では二十五分後に出て、乗車時間は十五分です。三番なら五分後に出ますが、乗換え先で待つ時間が出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: This timetable shows it departing in twenty-five minutes, with a fifteen-minute ride. Platform three departs in five minutes, but there'll be waiting time at the transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: センターの約束は一時間後なので、直行を待ちます。二番のりばまで地下を通りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一時間後の約束なので直行を待ち地下を通るか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: My appointment at the center is in an hour, so I'll wait for the direct bus. Do I go underground to reach platform two?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait for the direct service because your appointment is in an hour and ask whether to go underground. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 地下へ行かず、このフロアの案内線を進んでください。二番のりばの手前に待合の椅子があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't go underground; follow the guide line on this floor. There are waiting chairs just before platform two.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 椅子で待ちたいです。バスが来たかどうか、そこから見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 椅子で待ちながら到着したバスを見られるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to wait in a chair. Can I see from there whether the bus has arrived?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can see arriving buses while waiting in a chair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: のりばは見えますが、車体だけで判断せず、到着したバスの行先表示も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can see the platform, but don't judge only by the bus body. Check the arriving bus's destination display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二番の前で待って、乗るときに西口市民センターへ行くか運転手さんにも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二番で待ち行先を運転手にも確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait in front of platform two and ask the driver when boarding whether it goes to Nishiguchi Civic Center.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait at platform two and check the destination with the driver too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それなら乗り違いを防げますね。どうぞお気をつけて。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: That should prevent boarding the wrong bus. Take care, and have a good journey.
